Complete current official SOS Hennepin voting-precinct GeoJSON, 395 features with municipal FIPS, ward, county commissioner, judicial and park districts. Derived district geometries are unions of explicitly matching official precincts. County portions of cross-county cities are labeled as portions.
Official metadata and field definitions for the source voting-precinct layer.

Official MDE full school district source polygons in Hennepin bounding box. Only the 22 school districts independently confirmed by anonymous Hennepin ballot selections are treated as Hennepin districts; tiny adjacent border slivers are excluded.
Official school boundary layer metadata and school number/type field definitions.
Current 2026 municipal election page explicitly defines Section 2 as Wards 3 and 4, distinct from Ward 2.
Official park board description: five elected districts in suburban Hennepin County plus two county-appointed commissioners; official district city lists corroborate precise park electorates.
Current Minnesota Statutes 2.722 enumerates the Fourth Judicial District as Hennepin County.
